title: 🇪🇹 Ethiopia
description: Curated lists of the best coffee ceremonies, restaurants, and experiences in Ethiopia — researched from thousands of real Reddit reviews and travel guides.

places.name: 12 Best Coffee Ceremonies in Addis Ababa
places.description: The birthplace of coffee — from 1953-founded Tomoca to neighborhood jebena ceremonies. Historic roasters, specialty cafés, and the world's oldest coffee ritual.

places.name: 12 Best Injera Restaurants in Addis Ababa
places.description: The Reddit-backed guide to eating injera where it was born — from legendary Kategna to hidden kitfo specialists and the best doro wot in the city.

places.name: 13 Best Rock Churches in Lalibela
places.description: The ultimate guide to Lalibela's rock-hewn churches — 11 UNESCO World Heritage churches carved from solid volcanic rock, plus 2 nearby monasteries. Interactive map and real traveler tips.
